name: zclass_node_get_world_bbox_corners
description: zClass_Class::gwNodeGetWorldBBoxCorners expands a node cached world bounding box into the min/max corner tuple consumed by world-grid insertion.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass world/grid source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x4487c0 validates copying the node cached bounds into the corner structure used by world-grid callers.
